title: Compare bars
description: Two to four thick bars grow from one gold axis to their share of the frame width on a spring (Motion). The label sits inside its bar and is uncovered as the bar grows, and the large value rides the tip. A label that does not fit inside a short bar moves to the right of it.

props.items: required, 2-4 of {label, value, color: 2 or 3 for a content colour}: real numbers
props.title: heading, 3-7 words
props.highlight: which bar is gold, counted from 1 (default: the largest)
props.note: one small line under the bars
